name: Instant Knowledge Base – Create AI Supported Knowledge Base, Documentation, Wiki and Help Center
author: Seventh Sky

sections.description:
Instant Knowledgebase is an all-in-one WordPress plugin to create and manage an AI-powered knowledge base, wiki, internal documentation, or FAQ support center in just a few clicks. It’s designed for businesses, SaaS platforms, service providers, product developers, and anyone who needs to provide instant answers to customers, team members, or users.

From structured articles to live AJAX search, feedback voting, and mobile responsiveness — this plugin brings everything you need to build a modern self-service support system.

🚀 Core Features

  • Custom Post Type for Articles – Create well-structured, standalone knowledge base content.
  • Category-Based Organization – Group articles into logical sections for easy browsing.
  • Real-Time AJAX Search & Live Filters – Help users find answers instantly without reloading the page.
  • Shortcode [instant_knowledgebase] – Embed your full knowledge base on any page or post.
  • Pre-Built Layouts – Clean, modern templates that blend seamlessly with your theme.
  • User Role Access Control – Restrict documentation to logged-in users or specific roles.
  • Settings Panel – Customize layout, visibility, behavior, and access with ease.
  • Most Read Articles – Highlight your top-viewed articles dynamically.
  • Related Articles – Keep users engaged with automatic related content suggestions.
  • Like/Dislike Feedback System – Gather quick user sentiment on each article.
  • Custom Icons for Categories – Add icons for visual clarity and better UX.
  • Fully Mobile Responsive – Built to look great and work flawlessly on all devices.

👨‍💻 Help Center & Support

sections.installation:
You can install the Instant Knowledgebase plugin in three ways:

🔌 Automatic Installation (Recommended):

  1. Go to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “Instant Knowledgebase”.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.

💻 Manual Installation via FTP:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from the WordPress.org plugin page or here.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Upload the folder instant-knowledgebase to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory using FTP or your hosting file manager.
  4. Go to Plugins > Installed Plugins and click Activate.

🧩 Upload via WordPress Admin:

  1. Download the ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the downloaded ZIP file, click Install Now, and then click Activate.

Once activated:
– Navigate to Knowledge Base > Settings to configure options.
– Create a page and insert the shortcode [instant_knowledgebase] to display the knowledge base on your site.
sections.faq:
How do I display the knowledge base on my site?

Use the [instant_knowledgebase] shortcode on any WordPress page or post.

Can I restrict access to certain users?

Yes. You can enable user-role restrictions from Settings > Knowledge Base to control article visibility.

Is this plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, it is 100% responsive and optimized for phones and tablets.

Can I customize the look and feel?

Absolutely. Use your own CSS or override plugin templates to match your branding.

Does it include article analytics?

Yes. View counts and a like/dislike feedback system are built-in to track engagement.
